name: trifluridine
uses: INDICATIONS AND USAGE: Trifluridine Ophthalmic Solution is indicated for the treatment of primary keratoconjunctivitis and recurrent epithelial keratitis due to herpes simplex virus, types 1 and 2.
pediatric: Pediatric Use: Safety and effectiveness in pediatric patients below six years of age have not been established.
contra: CONTRAINDICATIONS: Trifluridine Ophthalmic Solution is contraindicated for patients who develop hypersensitivity reactions or chemical intolerance to trifluridine.
